nodes.title: Foam bond knock-down 0.5

nodes.title: Motor to mount: 4 x M3x8 into the motor base, incl. the 7 deg cant side load
nodes.equation: P = T/(K d); head bearing = P / (pi/4 (dh^2 - dhole^2)); cant side moment M_s = T_lim sin(cant) arm sf; screw tension F_t = ff (F/4 + (M + M_s)/s_min); separation RF = P / F_t; thread strip = 0.5 pi d e tau_Al with e = L_screw - plate (R3 canted plate, uniform grip)

nodes.title: Motor screws on the 7 deg canted plate: engagement and head seating
nodes.equation: R3 (D3): whole plate canted, faces parallel to the motor face, holes drilled square to the face -> engagement = L - plate at every hole; for record, the R2 layout (flat plate, canted 2 mm pads) would give L - (2.5 + 2 + tan(cant) max|t . hole|) and allow a screw lean of only atan((d_hole - d)/4.5 mm) against the cant

nodes.title: Mount collar on the tube under the 7 deg cant side force
nodes.equation: side S = T_lim sin(cant) along t = x_hat x r_hat = (0, -z/r, y/r); tube torsion Mz = S z/r (x_tube - x_prop); axial along the tube S y/r; design x sf ff pf; slip capacity Ts (torsion), Ts/(od/2) (axial, same friction)

nodes.title: Motor-mount slit collar: M3x16 + nyloc, rocking under the prop-nut torque
nodes.equation: protrusion = L - (2 ear + slit + nw wt); needed nyloc h + n p; clamp N = Ts/(mu pi r), bolt torque = K N d; rocking bearing p = 6 M/(od grip^2), M = Tprop sf ff pf; tube hoop = p r / t

nodes.title: Bus PDB on M3 heat-set inserts: engagement and pull-out
nodes.equation: engagement = L - stack >= kmin d (D-41); blind hole >= engagement + 0.5 mm; RF = pull-out / (F ff pf), whole crash load on one insert

nodes.title: Tube-in-block, block-on-spar and station-collar bonds
nodes.equation: tau = T / (2 pi r^2 L), T = T_ult ff pf; spar OD = tube OD (22 mm); tube bore L = core + 2 bosses; collar sizing (C4 method): tau = T_c4 sf ff pf / (2 pi r^2 h) + F_brace pf / (pi d h); h_req = (T/(2 pi r^2) + F/(pi d)) / tau

nodes.title: Edge-strip anchorage in the station collar and strip-to-board shear flow
nodes.equation: F = sigma_ult w t ff pf, sigma_ult = sigma_allow/(1+MS_edge) (C4 R3, two layers); anchor tau = F/(n w L); L_req = F/(2 w tau); shear flow q = F/L_strip onto the paper face, tau = q/w vs kd tau_board; pins through both layers: P = q pitch, shear P/(pi d^2/4), bending 32 P (n tb + t)/2 / (pi d^3)

nodes.title: Brace ends in their slots and the anchor saddle on the spar
nodes.equation: F_d = F (C4 R3, incl. 1.5 x 1.15) x pf; end bond tau = F_d / (2 (w+t) e); anchor saddle contact = len_y x (pi d_spar / 4) (90 deg wrap, C4 method), sigma = F_d / A vs peel

nodes.title: Foot shoe and fin root bonds at the C6 allowables
nodes.equation: foot shoe RF = SF_D5 kd (D5 used the undiscounted 0.20 MPa); fin root RF = RF_D3 kd

nodes.title: Pod joint allowables owned by C6 (CR-C3-05) and C3's pod joints re-checked
nodes.equation: C6 design allowable = kd x typical; C3 pod bond uses sigma_a = ASM-D2-XPS-ALLOW <= C6 and tau_a = min(ASM-C3-XPS-SHEAR, ASM-D5-BOND-TAU) = C6, so RF = 1/R (conservative); tray flat RF = kd f_b / sigma; floor glue RF = kd tau_b / sigma, with a fillet the glue width t -> t + leg; hatch tab RF = HL tension / demand

nodes.title: Servo frame and control horn: minimum bond area into XPS
nodes.equation: F = Mh/arm (V_D/V_B2)^2 sf ff pf (full deflection at VD: conservative vs F4's schedule, D-29); A_min = F / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Foot piston snap hook: minimum finger length
nodes.equation: cantilever snap fit eps = 1.5 t y / L^2  ->  L_min = sqrt(1.5 t y / eps)

nodes.title: Epoxy lap shear on abraded PETG, ASA and CF
nodes.procedure: 5 single-lap coupons each: PETG-CF and ASA-CF tube offcut, 25 x 12.5 mm overlap, 120 grit + IPA, 30 min epoxy, 24 h cure (+ 4 h at 50 degC for the ASA set); hang water jugs on a luggage scale to failure. Allowable = mean x 0.5; pass >= 2.0 MPa (ASM-C4-BOND-SHEAR)

nodes.title: Epoxy on paper-faced foam board, shear and flat-wise
nodes.procedure: 5 PETG tabs 20 x 20 mm bonded on a scuffed board face pulled in shear, 5 pulled flat-wise; record the failure mode (paper peels vs epoxy). Allowables = 0.5 x mean (replace ASM-D5-BOND-TAU x KD and ASM-C6-BOARD-FLAT-TYP x KD)

nodes.title: Flat-wise pull and shear of epoxy pucks on XPS
nodes.procedure: 10 printed pucks 30 mm dia bonded with microballoon epoxy on hot-wire-cut F-250 offcut: 5 pulled normal to the face, 5 pushed sideways; allowables = 0.5 x mean (replace ASM-D3-XPS-TENSILE and ASM-C6-XPS-SHEAR-TYP x KD)

nodes.title: Pod floor-to-wall corner under a strap pull
nodes.procedure: Two 100 mm long board U-sections (floor + two walls) glued edge-to-face as D2 builds the pod, one with the 6 mm fillets; pull a 20 mm strap off the floor with water jugs; pass >= 43 N (C3 per-strap design load: 85 N crash / 2 straps)

nodes.title: Heat-set insert pull-out
nodes.procedure: 3 inserts in a printed boss (same settings as POD-002), M3 screw + washer, pull to failure; pass >= 300 N each

nodes.title: Motor screw creep on a hot printed plate
nodes.procedure: Printed ASA mount plate on an aluminium block with 4 x M3x8 at 0.20 N m, 2 h at 70 degC (oven), cool, breakaway torque >= 0.15 N m on all four

nodes.title: Motor screws on the 7 deg canted mount
nodes.procedure: First printed mount A, holes drilled square to the canted face to the motor's pattern; fit the motor; 4 x M3x8 at 0.20 N m; count turns from first bite (>= 6 = 3.0 mm, <= probed depth - 0.5) and check a 0.05 mm feeler does not enter under any head

nodes.title: Edge-strip pull-out from the collar tail
nodes.procedure: Print the 40 mm two-face station collar tail alone; bond a 10 x 1 strip pair in it as built; pull along the strip with water jugs; pass >= F_design_n of CALC-C6-STRIP (700 N)

nodes.title: Prop-nut torque on a finished mount
nodes.procedure: Bell held by hand, prop nut to 1.5 N m and off 10 times; collar witness line and lip cap unmoved
